n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

oddCount = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCount = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if a[i - 1] % 2 != 0:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1

startIdx = 0
import heapq
differences = []

for i in range(1, n):
    oDiff = oddCount[i] - oddCount[startIdx]
    eDiff = evenCount[i] - evenCount[startIdx]
    if oDiff == eDiff:
        heapq.heappush(differences, abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        startIdx = i

totalCost = 0
selected = 0
while differences and totalCost + differences[0] <= b:
    totalCost += heapq.heappop(differences)
    selected += 1

print(selected)
</translated_code>
